correctness.rationale: The 20-vertex graph is explicit; 5,828 faces and seven mod-two boundary ranks were reconstructed by two independent exact finite programs. Rational reduced Euler characteristic -4 and mod-two homology concentrated rank four at degree five yield rational homology exactly Q^4 in degree five. Equivariant Hopf trace on all 120 automorphisms, via independently enumerated vertex cycle polynomials and oriented simplex signs, gives the stated class character. Classical A5xC2 identification and an inner product 1 prove W tensored with inversion sign is absolutely irreducible. Both embedded verifiers pass. No integral lattice or equivariant homotopy assertion.

value.rationale: The full symmetry of the dodecahedron is a canonical structural feature. Nonequivariant wedge-of-four-S5 tells only a four-dimensional rank; the module could have several different characters. Explicitly determining the full 120-element character, absolute irreducibility and the sign of antipodal inversion supplies a natural equivariant refinement not inferable from the previously recorded homotopy type; it is not an arbitrary numerical slice.
